about.label: About Us
about.title: More Than Just
about.description1: Fitness Sky Power opened its doors in 2009, simultaneously with the opening of Yavor Shopping Center. It is located on the third floor, offering a panoramic view that contributes to the wonderful atmosphere during workouts.
about.description2: A distinctive feature of the gym is the glass roof and large windows, which provide natural light and a sense of spaciousness.
about.description3: For the convenience of visitors, Yavor Shopping Center offers free parking, ensuring easy and convenient access to the gym at all times.
about.description4: Our mission is to provide a quality training environment, modern equipment, and a comfortable atmosphere where everyone feels motivated to give their best.

zones.title: Our Zones
zones.subtitle: Everything you need to achieve maximum results.

zones.title: Free Weights
zones.desc: Wide variety of dumbbells and free weights, ideal for isolation and basic strength exercises.

zones.title: Cardio Zone
zones.desc: High-class treadmills, cross trainers and ergometers for full cardio training and endurance.

zones.title: Machines with Integrated Weights
zones.desc: Equipment with an integrated weight stack that allows quick and easy load changes. They provide controlled, smooth movement, excellent muscle isolation, and maximum safety during training.

instructors.label: Our Instructors
instructors.title: Professional Team
instructors.description: Kremena and Petar Angelovi are the co-founders of the gym and people who believe that good results are achieved through professionalism, consistency, and a personal approach to every client.

kremena.name: Kremena Angelova
kremena.desc: Certified fitness instructor with 7 years of experience, specializing in working with women. She takes an individual approach to each client according to their goals, physical preparation, and lifestyle.

petar.name: Petar Angelov
petar.desc: Certified fitness instructor and competitor in the 'Men's Physique' category with over 15 years of experience. He helps clients build strength, muscle mass, and proper training habits.
